nodes.name: motor_service.py
nodes.summary: Coordinates asynchronous scan and enable lifecycles, immutable status snapshots and run-scoped sequenced targets/heartbeats. A single-worker executor owns hardware access, while a watchdog requests stops and schedules idle sensor reads; failures latch until an explicit scan.

nodes.name: MotorService
nodes.summary: Publishes locked lifecycle state and serializes scan, motion and cleanup on a single hardware executor, with heartbeat expiry and idle sensor monitoring.

nodes.name: MotorService.__init__
nodes.summary: Validates heartbeat timeout and initializes the hardware owner, state locks, single-worker executor and watchdog thread.

nodes.name: MotorService.snapshot
nodes.summary: Returns a deep-copied status document including device identities, sensor configuration, planned targets, axis enable feedback and cleanup results.

nodes.name: MotorService.scan
nodes.summary: Rejects busy/shutdown scans, validates the adapter, clears stale state and queues a hardware scan.

nodes.name: MotorService._scan
nodes.summary: Scans and reads sensors on the hardware executor; publishes devices on success or closes hardware and latches fault on failure.

nodes.name: MotorService.enable
nodes.summary: Validates selected scanned motors and motion profiles, starts a new run ID and heartbeat epoch, then queues continuous motion on the sole hardware worker.

nodes.name: MotorService._event
nodes.summary: Processes hardware readiness, axis/sensor telemetry, blocked-limit messages and phase updates under the service lock.

nodes.name: MotorService._run
nodes.summary: Runs native or injected legacy continuous control, publishes a bounded result and transitions to idle only after an intentional verified clean stop; otherwise latches fault.

nodes.name: MotorService.command
nodes.summary: Validates run and per-channel sequence, refuses expired heartbeats or unsafe endpoint targets, submits changed targets and refreshes heartbeat only for accepted requests.

nodes.name: MotorService.stop
nodes.summary: Requests shutdown of an active run, closes its target queue and enters stopping until the hardware worker completes parameter restoration.

nodes.name: MotorService._watchdog
nodes.summary: Requests a stop when an active heartbeat expires and schedules idle sensor reads on the existing hardware executor.

nodes.name: MotorService._poll_inputs
nodes.summary: Refreshes idle input telemetry on the hardware thread and publishes unavailable states if reads fail, always clearing the pending-poll flag.

nodes.name: MotorService.close
nodes.summary: Stops monitoring and motion, queues hardware lifecycle closure and waits for the executor so stop/disable/restoration cannot be abandoned.

nodes.name: test_aps_backend.py
nodes.summary: Exercises APS ABI bindings, configuration, topology and motion using a fake API with injected faults and sensor changes. Tests directional endpoint protection, stop/disable/restoration and real UDP integration, including proof that APS access stays on one hardware thread.

nodes.name: output
nodes.summary: Writes a ctypes output parameter through the original pointee for fake APS API responses.

nodes.name: FakeAPS
nodes.summary: Stateful fake APS API that records calls and hardware thread identities and models axes, bus state, sensor PDOs, mappings and injected motion/cleanup failures.

nodes.name: FakeAPS.__init__
nodes.summary: Creates reproducible card, bus, axis, sensor and parameter state with knobs for injected faults and delayed disable feedback.

nodes.name: FakeAPS.call
nodes.summary: Simulates APS lifecycle, topology, SDO/PDO, IO, motion and stop functions while recording calls and thread identity.

nodes.name: BindingTests
nodes.summary: Validates ctypes sizes/signatures, DLL load/export diagnostics and backend/APS configuration rejection rules.

nodes.name: BindingTests.test_abi_and_negative_error_diagnostic
nodes.summary: Verifies ctypes ABI sizes and signatures and the -4012 configuration diagnostic using a mocked DLL.

nodes.name: BindingTests.test_backend_config
nodes.summary: Checks default/derived card adapter and rejects legacy adapter, invalid APS types, unit mappings and overlapping endpoint inputs.

nodes.name: ControllerTests
nodes.summary: Tests fake-card scanning, axis/unit/direction conversion, endpoint interlocks, fault handling, persistent enable and complete stop/disable/restoration.

nodes.name: ControllerTests.run_motion
nodes.summary: Builds a motion queue and stop event, dispatches scripted actions after continuous readiness and collects the controller run report.

nodes.name: ControllerTests.test_mapping_gear_direction_and_moving_override
nodes.summary: Checks gear-scaled target and velocity conversion, reversed motor direction, moving target replacement, selected-axis ownership and cleanup restoration.

nodes.name: ControllerTests.test_sensor_bits_and_unknown_feedback
nodes.summary: Checks native limit/DI bit decoding, unconfigured states and unavailable feedback for incorrect PDO bit length or failed reads.

nodes.name: ControllerTests.test_bad_sensor_function_or_axis_prevents_scan
nodes.summary: Rejects unsupported driver DI function assignments and endpoint mappings to nonexistent APS axes.

nodes.name: ControllerTests.test_single_limit_blocks_outward_and_allows_inward_both_directions
nodes.summary: Checks outward rejection and permitted reverse escape for either configured native endpoint direction.

nodes.name: ControllerTests.test_dual_sensor_states_and_driver_configuration
nodes.summary: Checks dual endpoint clear/trigger/conflict states, missing feedback and validation of opposite driver DI functions and axis existence.

nodes.name: ControllerTests.test_dual_limits_block_either_end_and_allow_escape_with_ui_direction_conversion
nodes.summary: Exercises both endpoint directions, native/UI direction conversion and connected/unwired mapping settings while allowing only escape targets.

nodes.name: ControllerTests.test_both_endpoints_triggered_prevent_enable_and_fault_during_run
nodes.summary: Checks that conflicting endpoint sensors prevent servo enable and produce a fully disabled runtime fault.

nodes.name: ControllerTests.test_retraction_trigger_stops_motion_and_clearing_does_not_resume_old_target
nodes.summary: Triggers a retraction limit during motion and checks immediate stop with persistent enable and no automatic old-target restart after clearing.

nodes.name: ControllerTests.test_trigger_during_motion_stops_and_does_not_resume_on_clear
nodes.summary: Checks extension-trigger stopping, no automatic restart after clearing and later acceptance of an explicit reverse target.

nodes.name: ControllerTests.test_configured_sensor_failure_prevents_enable_and_stops_run
nodes.summary: Verifies unavailable configured endpoint feedback prevents preflight enable and faults/fully disables an already active run.

nodes.name: ControllerTests.test_native_limit_stop_allows_escape_but_other_astp_is_fault
nodes.summary: Allows reverse escape after a recognized directional native limit stop but treats an unrelated abnormal stop code as a fault.

nodes.name: ControllerTests.test_arrival_keeps_servo_enabled_until_explicit_stop
nodes.summary: Checks completed target accounting and feedback while the servo remains enabled until an explicit stop.

nodes.name: ControllerTests.test_unwired_limits_disable_only_selected_mapping_and_restore
nodes.summary: Checks that only selected unwired limit mappings are changed and that cleanup restores their original values.

nodes.name: ControllerTests.test_unwired_emg_releases_native_input_and_restores_on_close
nodes.summary: Checks explicit unwired EMG polarity release and restoration on controller close.

nodes.name: ControllerTests.test_unwired_emg_still_active_does_not_enable
nodes.summary: Checks a failed polarity release prevents any servo enable and restores the saved board setting.

nodes.name: ControllerTests.test_released_emg_historical_stop_clears_on_explicit_target
nodes.summary: Checks historical stopped ASTP state after unwired EMG release permits only a new explicit motion target.

nodes.name: ControllerTests.test_runtime_faults_and_stop_fallback
nodes.summary: Injects alarm/offline/bus/abnormal/target failures and failed deceleration stops, checking emergency-stop fallback, disable results and lifecycle invalidation.

nodes.name: ControllerTests.test_card_discovery_and_close_on_failed_start
nodes.summary: Checks wrong/missing card and failed bus start trigger APS closure and restoration of original board settings.

nodes.name: ControllerTests.test_boot_auto_connected_bus_and_explicit_eni_regeneration
nodes.summary: Verifies a valid already-operational bus is adopted and explicit ENI regeneration orders stop, scan and start correctly.

nodes.name: APSUDPTests
nodes.summary: Exercises real UDP requests and heartbeats against a fake APS card, checking endpoint escape, conflict faults, idle sensor telemetry and one-thread hardware ownership.

nodes.name: APSUDPTests.test_udp_dual_limits_escape_each_end_and_latch_conflict
nodes.summary: Exercises both endpoint escape directions over UDP and verifies simultaneous endpoint activation latches a fully disabled fault on one hardware thread.

nodes.name: APSUDPTests.test_udp_rejects_extension_at_limit_and_accepts_retraction
nodes.summary: Checks unsafe endpoint UDP targets preserve target sequence and issue no move, while a reverse target is accepted with independent heartbeats.

nodes.name: APSUDPTests.test_idle_inputs_update_over_udp_without_enabling_any_motor
nodes.summary: Checks idle sensor transitions and unavailable feedback propagate through UDP while no servo or trajectory call occurs.

nodes.name: APSUDPTests.test_real_udp_target_and_heartbeat_stop_with_single_hardware_thread
nodes.summary: Checks scan/enable/target UDP flow, selected APS axes, heartbeat expiry stopping, single hardware-thread access and restored bus/board lifecycle.

nodes.name: test_udp_ui.py
nodes.summary: Tests the Tk UDP frontend against injected legacy hardware and a local server. Verifies selection, hidden-window heartbeats, isolated tray client launch and endpoint displays that distinguish trigger, conflict, unavailable and stale feedback.

nodes.name: UITests
nodes.summary: Exercises the UDP Tk control UI and tray launch isolation with a fake EtherCAT controller, including hidden-window continuity and stale sensor rendering.

nodes.name: UITests.test_ui_uses_udp_selection_and_hides_without_stopping
nodes.summary: Checks UDP axis selection and target control, safe range changes, continued heartbeats while hidden, usable layout and explicit disable.

nodes.name: UITests.test_backend_tray_launches_separate_client_without_tk
nodes.summary: Mocks tray launch to verify a separate UdpControl process receives the actual UDP port and the backend initializes no injected hardware.

nodes.name: UITests.test_sensor_display_distinguishes_trigger_unknown_and_no_retraction_sensor
nodes.summary: Checks trigger styling, raw DI display, absent retraction sensor and unavailable/stale feedback rendering.

nodes.name: UITests.test_dual_endpoint_display_and_stale_feedback
nodes.summary: Checks opposite endpoint labels, conflict faults and separate unavailable/stale rendering for configured retraction sensors.
